hero.eyebrow: Secret Santa for family and friends
hero.title: Organize a Secret Santa without the fuss
hero.lead: Invite your family or friends by link or by email. Givto draws the names, keeps the wishlists and runs gift day.

secretSanta.title: Secret Santa
secretSanta.description: Everyone draws one name in secret and gets that person a gift. Nobody draws their own name, and nobody finds out who their Santa is until gift day.

whiteElephant.title: White elephant
whiteElephant.description: Everyone brings one wrapped gift to a shared pile. Take turns: unwrap a new one, or steal one that's already open.

conspiracy.title: Conspiracy Santa
conspiracy.description: Everyone gets one gift from all the others, planned together on a board that person can't see.

start.title: Start and invite
start.description: Give it a name, a gift day and a budget. Share the link or its QR code, or invite people by email.

draw.title: Draw names
draw.description: Draw when everyone's in, or on a date you pick. Each person only sees who they're buying for.

wishlists.title: Fill in your wishlist
wishlists.description: Add a few wishes so your Santa knows what to get you. Paste a shop link and Givto fills in the details.

gift-day.title: Gift day
gift-day.description: Unwrap in turns, around the table or on a video call, and guess who your Santa was.

wishlist.title: One wishlist for all your groups
wishlist.description: Keep one wishlist and choose which groups see each wish. Santas call Dibs! on what they're buying, so you don't get the same gift from two groups.

secrets.title: Ask without giving yourself away
secrets.description: As a Santa, ask your giftee a question or send a Psst! when their wishlist needs more ideas. Anyone can leave a tip for someone's Santa. Nobody sees who you're buying for.

mock.question: Question from your Santa
mock.psst-text: Your Santa would love more detail on your wishes.
mock.tip-text: She's had her eye on the green scarf at the market.

giftday.title: Gift day on the big screen
giftday.description: Givto shuffles who unwraps when. Put the presenter view on the TV or share it on a video call, guess on your phones who each gift is from, and see who was whose Santa at the end.

apart.title: Keep couples apart
apart.description: Couples and housemates never draw each other, and nobody gets last year's person again.

post.title: Gifts by post
post.description: Far apart? Only your Santa sees your address, and they mark when your gift is on its way.

link.title: Paste a shop link
link.description: Givto fills in the name, picture and price of a wish.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Givto nudges anyone with an empty wishlist or an unbought gift, and gift day goes in your calendar.

editions.title: Same again next year
editions.description: Start again with the same group. Last year's wishlists and draw stay there to look back on.

phones.title: Made for phones
phones.description: English or Dutch, light or dark, and no app to install.

account.question: Does everyone need an account?
account.answer: Just an email address. No password and no app.

secret.question: Who can see who drew whom?
secret.answer: Nobody, not even the organizer. If you like, everyone finds out who was whose Santa at the end of gift day.

apart.question: Can I keep couples apart?
apart.answer: Yes. Put them in the same Keep apart row and they won't draw each other.

late.question: Can someone join after the draw?
late.answer: Yes. Anyone who joins after the draw still gets someone to buy for.

far.question: We don't live close. Does it still work?
far.answer: Yes. Add your address and only your Santa sees it. Gift day works on a video call too.

cost.question: What does it cost?
cost.answer: Nothing. Givto is free and open source.

data.question: What happens to my data?
data.answer: We only keep what your Secret Santa needs and delete it when it's no longer needed. Read the <link>privacy page</link>.

closing.title: Ready when you are
closing.lead: Start a Secret Santa in a minute and share the link in the group chat.
